Package hkust.marketplace.service

Class ChatService

java.lang.Object
hkust.marketplace.service.ChatService
public class ChatService extends Object
Private chat linked to a listing (Task 1.5). There is one thread per buyer and listing, shared by the buyer and the seller. History is kept permanently and is searchable.

    • send

      public ChatMessage send(String threadId, String senderId, String text)
      Sends a free-text message and notifies the other participant.
      Parameters:
      threadId - thread
      senderId - buyer or seller of the thread
      text - 1 to 1,000 characters, not only spaces
      Returns:
      the stored message
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the text is empty or too long
      MarketplaceException - if the sender is not in the thread or the thread is read-only

    • search

      public List<ChatService.SearchHit> search(String userId, String keyword, String threadId)
      Searches chat history, ignoring case.
      Parameters:
      userId - the searching user (only their own threads are searched)
      keyword - keyword, not blank
      threadId - search only this thread, or null for all the user's threads
      Returns:
      matching messages, oldest first
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the keyword is blank
